records.description: Flughafensee is a wooded lake near the former Tegel airport in northern Berlin, with nudist bathing spots and quieter paths around the shore. Two gay directories describe it as a possible cruising area, but the newer posts mostly concern whether the beach is accessible, not men actually meeting. A July 2026 visitor said the FKK shore had reopened, while August comments ask about privacy; the clearer sexual-activity claims date back to 2023. A previous report mentioned unstable slopes and fencing, so you should follow current signs rather than assume all paths are open. This remains a public bathing area shared with other visitors, with no credible contemporary estimate of the cruising crowd, best times or exact meeting section.
blockers: 2026 posts concern shoreline access/questions, not encounters
Old 2023 claims do not prove current cruising
Slope and fence restrictions need current verification
records.opening_notes: Outdoor lake and FKK shoreline; follow current access and safety signs.

records.description: Grunewald is enormous, so the useful detail here is that this particular old cruising reference is about Pappelplatz near S-Bahn Grunewald, not the separate Jagen 87, Jagen 90 or Teufelssee locations. The directory describes paths from the nursery-side car park towards a former sports field, about a short walk from the station. Historic accounts mention a mixture of ages and leather visitors at night; those are not reliable demographic data for today. An August 2026 visitor actually explored the area and noticed some men walking around on weekdays but reported no meeting. It is easy to visit on public woodland paths, but privacy, forestry rules and daylight vary. Without a more substantial recent account, the old promises of constant activity remain too optimistic.
blockers: Recent visitor observed men but no confirmed cruising
Source counts cover some broad forest references
records.tags: Forest, Car Park, Daytime, Historical Cruising
records.opening_notes: Older directory claims night activity; 2026 observation concerned weekday daylight.

records.description: Jagen 90 is a clearing and woodland section in Berlin's Grunewald, historically associated with Dahlemer Feld, rather than the better-known Pappelplatz area. Older gay guides describe naturist sunbathing and cruising on the forest meadow, with access on foot from the surrounding paths or the Kleiner Stern area. May 2026 reports are useful but contradictory: one visitor said they couldn't find the clearing after several attempts, while another thought the directory map pin was wrong and mentioned only occasional men. No dated encounter was documented. Don't use a questionable pin as reliable directions, and stay outside protected grazing enclosures or closed restoration zones. A more precise location and realistic visiting pattern are needed before this could become a usable recommendation.
records.opening_notes: Outdoor daylight meadow; no reliable day or time for cruising.

records.description: Habermannsee is one of the Kaulsdorfer Seen in Berlin's eastern districts, with paths and grassy shoreline around a former gravel pit. The old gay directory points towards the lake meadows near Kressenweg, with S-Bahn Kaulsdorf providing a practical approach. Warm summer days are the traditional time to find men here, but recent reports aren't limited to summer: January and April 2026 visitors claimed encounters, while other June visitors described little cruising or complained about sexual activity visible to families. Expect a mixed public recreation area rather than a men-only beach, and don't count on a particular age range. This is an environmentally sensitive drinking-water protection and landscape zone; Berlin's official information says swimming is prohibited. Stay on permitted paths, protect the reed beds, and keep all sexual behaviour private and consensual, away from other bathers and children.
records.tags: Lake, Outdoor, Meadow, Summer, Recent Reports, Conservation
records.opening_notes: Open recreation paths subject to conservation limits; summer daytime suggested by directory, but winter visitor claims also exist. Swimming prohibited.
caveats: Multiple recent reports conflict on how active it is
Visible public sexual activity affecting other visitors has been complained about

records.description: Schillerpark in Wedding is a broad, historic park used by local families and walkers. Two gay directories carry a cruising reference, but the exact area is confused: some older accounts mention a former public toilet, while others point to the paths near Dubliner and Edinburger Straße. The more recent evidence is not encouraging. In June 2026, one visitor spent about two hours looking around and saw nobody apparently seeking sex. The toilet mentioned in old listings may no longer operate, and some pathways provide very little privacy. This isn't evidence the whole park is always empty, but it doesn't support advertising the location as an active cruising spot with a particular crowd or time. Its historic references should be retained in research, not promoted as current facts.
records.tags: Historic Park, Former Public Toilet, Unverified
records.opening_notes: Normal municipal park access; no substantiated current peak time.
